Termexo flashes the taskbar, sends a system notification, and keeps a banner on screen until you deal with it — for every project you have open, not just the one in front of you. Waiting for approval, waiting for input, and finished all look different at a glance Works even when the Termexo window is already focused Click the banner to jump straight to that terminal One agent needs a decision. The other is still working. Every local session, searchable and one click from resuming 03 / NOTHING IS LOST Pick up yesterday's conversation. Claude Code and Codex already save your sessions on disk. Termexo simply lists them so you can search and reopen one — it calls the CLI's own resume, so the full context comes back. Nothing you close is really lost. Search across every project by name, path, branch, or model Resumes through the real `claude --resume` and `codex resume` Your session files are read-only — Termexo never edits or deletes them 04 / MODEL ROUTING Same CLI. Project folder, grid layout, which terminals were open, what model each was running, even the colour you picked — it all comes back with the workspace. WORKS TODAY 文 Works in your language Follow Windows automatically or switch between Chinese, English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, and Korean at any time. 中 EN ES FR DE 日 한 COMING LATER ◔ See your quota before you burn it Check how much of your plan is left and when it resets, before you decide which model to send the next task to. Anthropic 72% DeepSeek 46% MiniMax 84% COMING LATER ⌁ Approve it from your phone Step away from the desk and still let an agent through the approval it is waiting on, over an encrypted link to your own machine. ▱ T ▯ 06 / ROADMAP What comes next. Everything above already works. Here is what is being built, and in what order — nothing on this list is being sold as finished. V0.3 YOU ARE HERE Run several agents side by side Claude and Codex detection, separate logins, resume, custom grids, model profiles, seven interface languages, and everything saved locally. V0.4 PLANNED Accounts, installs, and networks Install or upgrade the CLIs in one click, keep several logins apart, set up proxies for a company network, and watch how much plan quota is left. V0.5–0.6 PLANNED Handing work between agents Session summaries, moving a task from one agent to another, routing work, and notifications. V0.7 PLANNED Reaching your desk from anywhere Paired devices, encrypted remote terminals, approving from a phone, clear roles, and an audit trail. 07 / PRIVACY It all stays on your computer. Termexo has no account, no server, and nothing to sync. Later versions add remote access — but only the kind you switch on yourself and can switch off just as fast. 01 Local by default Your project paths, sessions, terminal state, and settings sit in a file on your disk. There is no cloud service to sign into. 02 Your API keys are not in a config files Keys go into Windows Credential Manager. The app stores only a reference, and the interface can tell you a key exists but never show it back. 03 Your agent files are read-only Termexo reads what Claude Code and Codex write, and uses their own resume commands. It never rewrites, renames, or deletes your session history. BUILD WITH US One command. No account. The npm package ships the whole Windows app. Run it, and if you do not like it, delete it — nothing was created anywhere else. source_pages.title: FreqWave EQ — Browser Audio Equalizer
source_pages.excerpt: FreqWave EQ — Browser Audio Equalizer Freq Wave EQ Privacy Chrome Extension · Available Now Audio EQ for every tab you watch & listen FreqWave EQ brings the audio control you need to your browser. 8-band equalizer, voice enhancement, live visualizer — all processed locally, zero servers. Add to Chrome Add to Edge View on GitHub 8-Band Equalizer --> 32 64 125 250 500 1k 4k 8k Features Only what you need, nothing you don't Built for people who care about their audio quality — whether it's a podcast, a movie, or a YouTube video with a bad mix. 🎚 8-Band Parametric EQ Full-range control from 32 Hz to 8 kHz. Each band adjustable ±12 dB with precise per-slider control. Flat by default — only shape what needs shaping. 🎙 Voice Enhancer Four curated presets — Off, Dialogue, Leveler, and Clarity — each tuned for a different listening scenario. Leveler includes a dynamics compressor ( DSP ). 📊 Live FFT Visualizer Real-time spectrum display driven by the post-processing audio signal, so you see exactly what you're hearing after the EQ curve is applied. 🔒 100% Local Processing All audio processing happens inside your browser using the Web Audio API. No audio data ever leaves your device. No servers, no accounts, no tracking. 💾 Persistent Settings Your EQ curve, knob positions, and Voice Enhancer mode are saved automatically. Open the extension a week later and your settings are exactly where you left them. ⚡ Low-Latency Routing Tab capture runs in an offscreen document separate from your page, so the extension never touches the page DOM and doesn't slow down the site you're on. Voice Enhancer Four modes for every source Pre-tuned curves that fix common audio problems in one click. Switch modes without stopping playback. Off Bypass Voice Enhancer inactive. Your manual EQ curve and gain settings still apply. Use this when you want full manual control. Dialogue Speech clarity Cuts low mud, boosts upper-mid presence. Designed for podcasts and videos where voice sits too far back in the mix. Leveler Speech Leveler Adds a dynamics compressor to even out loud and quiet passages. Ideal for content with inconsistent levels, like live recordings. Clarity Air & Detail Progressive high-frequency lift that opens up the sound. Works well on compressed streaming audio that sounds dull or closed-in. How it works Start in three steps 1 Install the extension Load FreqWave EQ from the Chrome Web Store or install it unpacked in Developer mode via chrome://extensions. 2 Open the popup on any tab Click the FreqWave EQ icon while on a tab playing audio — YouTube, Spotify, a podcast site, anything. Hit the Engine pill to start capture. 3 Shape your sound Adjust the 8-band EQ, tweak Master Volume and Pre-Amp, and pick a Voice Enhancer mode. Changes apply in real time with no buffering or interruption. 🛡️ Your audio stays yours FreqWave EQ processes everything locally using the Web Audio API. No audio is recorded, no data is sent to any server, and there are no accounts or logins. Settings are stored on your device via Chrome's built-in sync storage. Read the full privacy policy → Freq Wave EQ A personal project. Not affiliated with Google or Chrome. Developed by Borislav Ginov Privacy GitHub
